Thiruvananthapuram Corporation meeting disrupted by councillor clashes

A meeting of the Thiruvananthapuram Corporation descended into chaos with clashes between councillors from the BJP and Congress (UDF). The disruption occurred amidst protests by the Opposition LDF and UDF against the continued presence of a BJP councillor who was arrested. Reports indicate physical altercations, including the assault of women councillors and attempts to seize the attendance register.
